original.target_description: Related target outcome located: ANCOVAs of correct face-location identifications divided by correct plus incorrect identifications, age covariate. One Helsinki-recruited sample is reported, not a Japanese or American sample. Separate paranormal-believer/skeptic and religious/non-religious comparisons are printed; supplied locator does not distinguish them.

n.sample_role: No analytic n for the country-specific target established. Related analyses use upper/lower quartile groups; generic study N=47 is not the target analytic n.
n.exclusions: Originally 73 recruited; 47 included overall; upper/lower belief quartiles retained for group analyses (19 paranormal believers/20 skeptics; 20 religious/19 nonreligious).
n.quote: Only those belonging to the upper and lower quartiles (25%)
